授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
This is an advanced course for learning academic English aiming to develop advanced reading skills and the ability to write a research paper. To be able to read papers on various topics, students will be required to read introductory chapters on various fields using a textbook. Students will also learn how to collect statistical information and data, and how to incorporate these data into their research paper. In addition, students will learn academic words using a wordbook.
Students will be divided into small groups and will be asked to cooperate with other members.
